question: Sitting in a row, Wilson, Peter, Yagnik and Zohra are watching TV. Yagnik is sitting at the left side of Zohra, who is at the left side of Wilson. Who is at the left side of Yagnik if he is NOT sitting at any end of the row?
solution: Sitting in a row, **Wilson, Peter, Yagnik and Zohra** are watching TV. 1. Yagnik is sitting at the left side of Zohra, who is at the left side of Wilson. 2. If Yagnik is NOT sitting at any end of the row.
